messages:
anya: Heads-up: upcoming enterprise wants BYOK import into our proxy with escrowless option. Sales needs a short FAQ for Legal: RBAC change windows, audit evidence format, and IR SLOs. tagging @paul @marta

paul: Suggestion: enforce JIT-only for import ops by default. Roles: `kms-admin` (no import), `importer` (JIT, MFA, 2 approvers), `auditor` (readonly). JIT tokens should be STS sessions with tags: ticket_id, approver_ids, ttl.

marta: For audit: daily signed bundle (ed25519), include HSM serial + firmware SHA256 + vendor attestation if available. Bundle = gzipped JSONL + RFC3161 timestamp on the merkle root. Store in Object Lock (governance) + optional mirror to customer S3.

anya: Legal asking: can we promise 3-year immutable retention? Also what happens on suspected operator compromise — short bulleted flow please.

paul: Yes on retention technically: Object Lock + lifecycle to cold archive. Costs must be surfaced. Incident shortflow: 1) revoke RBAC (auto), 2) snapshot & sign forensic export, 3) block further imports for that HSM model if vuln, 4) rewrap/rotate KEK we control, 5) notify customer per SLA.

marta: Vulnerability triage note: require pre-import firmware allowlist. Proxy must accept headers `X-HSM-SERIAL` and `X-HSM-FW-SHA256` and compare to onboarding allowlist. If firmware is on denylist -> block import and open P0. If unknown -> require attestation before proceed.

paul: Minimal policy snippet (pseudo):
```
Allow if principal.role == "importer" && context.ticket_id != null && context.mfa == true && context.jit_expires > now
```
Enforce via STS session tags + authorization lambda.

sec-bot: advisory: vendor-hsm-cve-2026-1099 flagged for models "Pulse-2" and "Pulse-3". Check onboarding lists.

anya: Also need tamper evidence details for compliance. Is signature + TSA enough or should we include merkle + transparency log?

marta: Recommend merkle root + RFC3161 timestamp + publish root to read-only transparency topic. That gives per-event inclusion proofs for customer verification. Include signer cert chain and TSA response in bundle.

paul: Operational constraints: our proxy currently only supports single-op imports. If customer requires dual-operator, options: (a) customer provides threshold/remote HSM, (b) manual dual-op process (documented witness + audit video + signed attestations). Document both in onboarding checklist.

infra-bot: ticket-created: ENGSEC-6120 (BYOK escrowless onboarding checklist)

anya: Action items: Paul -> draft JIT RBAC + approval workflow; Marta -> signed bundle spec + allowlist pre-import check; I'll draft SOW Q&A and send to Legal. Shareable with Sales?

paul: Shareable.

marta: Fine by me.

anya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
